METALWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

3. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.

4. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.

5. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.

6. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

8. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

9. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.

10. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.

11. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

12. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Centre La and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Project 1 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
